title: The same statements with a secondary index on the period columns
unit: milliseconds (median of 7), handler reads for one run
source: labs/history-at-scale: uv run bench.py, uv run build.py, uv run report.py
note: flat has the product's indexes. idx adds pe (page_id, row_end), ps (page_id, row_start), se (row_start, row_end), es (row_end, row_start) and lets the optimizer choose; idx_pe, idx_ps, idx_se and idx_es force one of them.
